title: Admin Essentials
description: Server-side Fabric moderation and admin utility mod
body:
Admin Mod is a server-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that combines moderation, admin utilities, permission-based command access, and localization in one lightweight package.  
It includes core admin commands (`/bc`, `/tps`, `/vanish`, `/invsee`, `/near`, `/rename`, `/lore`), permission management with tab-complete (`/allowcommand`, `/denycommand`), and a full punishment system (`/ban`, `/mute`, `/tempban`, `/tempmute`, `/unban`, `/unmute`, `/untempban`, `/untempmute`).  
The mod supports custom broadcast tags, JSON-based punishment storage, automatic temporary punishment expiration, chat/private-message blocking for muted players, and locale files via `config/locales/locale_(countrycode).loc`.  
It is designed for survival, anarchy, and minigame servers that need practical moderation tools without a heavy plugin stack.
